description: DELTIN ROYALE GOA Deltin Royale, anchored on the Mandovi River in Goa, is India’s largest and most luxurious floating casino, offering an unparalleled blend of gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. Spread across 40,000 square feet, it features a wide array of games, including poker, roulette, blackjack, and slot machines, with exclusive VIP rooms for high rollers. Beyond gaming, Deltin Royale delights guests with live performances, gourmet dining options, and a well-stocked bar. Its opulent interiors, impeccable service, and scenic river views make it a premier destination for both gaming enthusiasts and those seeking a lavish experience in Goa. DELTIN ROYALE CASINO Deltin Royale Casino, situated on the Mandovi River in Goa, is a premier floating casino renowned for its luxurious ambience and exceptional gaming experience. Spread across a massive 40,000 square feet, it features over 100 gaming tables offering games like poker, roulette, blackjack, baccarat, and slot machines. Designed to cater to all, the casino includes exclusive VIP lounges for high-stakes players and a kid’s zone for family-friendly entertainment. Guests can enjoy live music, international performances, and multi-cuisine dining, all set against the backdrop of stunning river views. Deltin Royale combines elegance, entertainment, and world-class service, making it a must-visit destination in Goa. DELTIN ROYALE TICKETS Tickets for Deltin Royale in Goa can be booked online or directly at the entry point. The pricing typically includes entry, access to the gaming floors, a set amount of playing chips, unlimited food and beverages (alcoholic and non-alcoholic), and live entertainment. DELTIN ROYALE ENTRY FEE The entry fee for Deltin Royale varies depending on the day, package, and inclusions. Here’s an approximate breakdown: Standard Entry Fees Weekdays: ₹3,000 to ₹4,000 per person. Weekends: ₹4,000 to ₹5,000 per person. VIP Packages ₹8,000 and above, offering exclusive access to premium gaming areas, higher-value chips, and personalized services. DELTIN ROYALE OWNER Deltin Royale is owned by Delta Corp Limited, one of India’s largest gaming and hospitality companies. Delta Corp operates multiple casinos and luxury properties in India and abroad, with Deltin Royale being its flagship casino. The company is known for pioneering the organized casino industry in India and is listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) and the National Stock Exchange (NSE). DELTIN ROYALE DRESS CODE Deltin Royale maintains a smart casual dress code to ensure a sophisticated ambience for all guests. Here are the details: Allowed Attire Men: Collared shirts or T-shirts, trousers, jeans, and closed-toe shoes. Women: Dresses, smart casual outfits, skirts, or jeans with tops. Not Allowed Sleeveless shirts or vests for men. Shorts, flip-flops, or beachwear for both men and women. Sportswear or overly casual attire like pajamas. It’s advisable to dress comfortably but presentably, keeping the upscale environment in mind. For VIP areas, a more formal dress code might be encouraged. DELTIN ROYALE VS BIG DADDY Deltin Royale and Big Daddy Casino are two top floating casinos in Goa, each offering unique experiences. Deltin Royale is known for its opulent ambience, exclusive VIP lounges, and a focus on luxury with a wide range of gaming options, fine dining, and international live performances. In contrast, Big Daddy Casino delivers a vibrant, energetic atmosphere with Bollywood-themed shows, modern gaming setups, and slightly more affordable entry fees. While Deltin Royale appeals to those seeking sophistication and elegance, Big Daddy is ideal for guests looking for a lively and interactive casino experience. DELTIN ROYALE COUPLE PACKAGE Deltin Royale offers a couple of packages designed to provide a luxurious and memorable experience for two. These packages typically include entry, gaming chips, unlimited food and beverages, and entertainment. Approximate Couple Package Details Price: ₹7,000 to ₹8,000 (varies by day and season). Inclusions: Entry for two. Complimentary play chips (amount depends on the package). Unlimited buffet with multi-cuisine options. Unlimited drinks, including premium alcohol. Access to live entertainment and performances. VIP Couple Packages Price: ₹15,000 and above. Inclusions: Entry to VIP gaming areas. Higher-value complimentary chips. Personalized service and exclusive lounge access. Premium food and beverages. It’s recommended to book in advance, especially during weekends or peak tourist seasons, to secure the best package and avoid last-minute rush. DELTIN ROYALE CRUISE The Deltin Royale Cruise is an exclusive experience offered by Deltin Royale on the Mandovi River in Goa. This floating casino is anchored on a luxury cruise ship, providing guests with an upscale gaming and entertainment experience. While the casino itself is docked, it offers a “cruise-like” experience with panoramic river views, live entertainment, and gourmet dining on board. The cruise experience includes: World-class gaming with options like poker, roulette, blackjack, and slots. Exquisite dining with multi-cuisine buffets and a premium bar offering top-tier spirits. Live performances featuring international artists, music, and dance shows. Scenic river views, make it an ideal setting for a glamorous night out. Though it is technically a docked casino, the ambience and experience aboard the Deltin Royale are akin to a luxury cruise, offering an unforgettable and lavish evening in Goa. DELTIN ROYALE FOOD Deltin Royale offers a luxurious dining experience with a diverse selection of multi-cuisine options, including Indian, Chinese, Continental, and Goan dishes. Guests can enjoy a lavish buffet spread featuring everything from tandoori items and curries to pastas and seafood, or opt for à la carte dishes for a more personalized meal. The casino also features live counters for freshly prepared food and a premium bar with a variety of top-shelf spirits, cocktails, and mocktails. With its gourmet offerings, Deltin Royale ensures that every dining experience is as exciting and refined as its gaming atmosphere. DELTIN GAME Deltin Royale offers a wide variety of games catering to all types of players, from beginners to high rollers. The casino features both classic and modern games, creating an exciting and dynamic gaming experience. Here are some of the popular games available at Deltin Royale: Poker: Including variants like Texas Hold'em and Omaha, offering both cash games and tournaments. Blackjack: The classic card game where players aim to get as close to 21 as possible without exceeding it. Roulette: One of the most popular casino games, where players bet on where the ball will land on a spinning wheel. Baccarat: A high-stakes game where players bet on the outcome of the deal between the player and the banker. Teen Patti: A traditional Indian card game, often referred to as "Indian Poker," offering a fun and competitive atmosphere. Slot Machines: A variety of modern video slots with different themes and progressive jackpots. Rummy: The classic card game, popular among Indian players. In addition to these, Deltin Royale regularly hosts live entertainment, providing an all-around experience for guests looking to enjoy both gaming and entertainment in one venue. DELTIN ROYALE REVIEWS Deltin Royale receives generally positive reviews for its luxurious ambience, a wide range of gaming options, and live entertainment. Visitors often highlight the professionalism of the staff, the quality of the gaming experience, and the overall grandeur of the casino. Many appreciate the inclusions like unlimited food, beverages, and live performances as part of the entry package. However, some guests mention issues such as overcrowding, long waiting times, and inconsistent food quality. A few have also noted that certain areas could benefit from better maintenance. While many enjoy the vibrant atmosphere and premium experience, reviews suggest that the experience may vary based on crowd levels and individual expectations. DELTIN ROYALE HOW TO REACH FROM DABOLIM AIRPORT (GOA INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT) Distance: Approximately 27 km (around 45 minutes by car). Route: Take the NH66 highway to Panaji, and then head towards the Mandovi River. Deltin Royale is docked along the riverfront. FROM MADGAON RAILWAY STATION (SOUTH GOA) Distance: Around 90 km (2 hours by car). Route: Drive via NH66 towards Panaji, passing through areas like Margao and Verna, then proceed to the riverfront to reach Deltin Royale. FROM PANAJI (CITY CENTER) Distance: Just a 10-15 minute drive from central Panaji. Route: Head to the Mandovi River and look for signs directing you to Deltin Royale’s docked location. You can also take a local taxi or autorickshaw to the casino. BY TAXI OR PRIVATE CAR Taxis are easily available from various locations around Goa, including popular tourist areas such as Calangute, Baga, and Anjuna. Private cars can be booked for a direct, hassle-free ride. BY SHUTTLE SERVICES Some hotels and resorts offer shuttle services to Deltin Royale. Check with your accommodation in advance if they provide transportation to the casino. BY BOAT Deltin Royale is a floating casino, so they may offer boat transfers for guests arriving by river, depending on availability and packages. It’s recommended to check with the casino in advance for the most convenient travel options based on your location in Goa. DELTIN ROYALE NEARBY ATTRACTIONS MIRAMAR BEACH Distance: 4 km (about 10 minutes by car). A popular beach with golden sands and gentle waves, Miramar Beach is perfect for a relaxing stroll, enjoying the sunset, or indulging in some water sports. DONA PAULA VIEWPOINT Distance: 5 km (about 15 minutes by car). A scenic viewpoint offering panoramic views of the Arabian Sea and the Mormugao Harbor. It's a lovely spot to capture photographs or just enjoy the breeze. BASILICA OF BOM JESUS Distance: 4 km (about 15 minutes by car). A UNESCO World Heritage site, this 16th-century church is famous for housing the mortal remains of St. Francis Xavier. The beautiful baroque architecture and peaceful surroundings make it a must-visit for history and culture enthusiasts. SE CATHEDRAL Distance: 4.5 km (about 15 minutes by car). One of the largest churches in Asia, known for its impressive Portuguese-Gothic style architecture and its historical significance. FONTAINHAS LATIN QUARTER Distance: 2 km (about 10 minutes by car). A charming heritage neighbourhood in Panaji, featuring colourful Portuguese-style houses, narrow lanes, and vibrant streets that reflect Goa’s colonial past. REIS MAGOS FORT Distance: 6 km (about 15 minutes by car). This 16th-century fort offers great views of the Mandovi River and the Arabian Sea. It also has a small museum that showcases Goa's history. CHAPORA FORT Distance: 26 km (about 45 minutes by car). Known for its stunning views of Vagator Beach and the surrounding coastline, this fort offers a glimpse into Goa's historical fortifications and was featured in the Bollywood movie Dil Chahta Hai. OUR LADY OF THE IMMACULATE CONCEPTION Distance: 1.5 km (about 5 minutes by car). A beautiful and historic church in Panaji offering panoramic views of the city and the Mandovi River

What is Deltin Royale?

Deltin Royale is India’s largest floating casino, located on the Mandovi River in Goa. It offers a luxurious gaming experience with a variety of table games, slot machines, live entertainment, and fine dining.

What games are available at Deltin Royale?

Deltin Royale features a wide range of games, including Poker, Blackjack, Roulette, Baccarat, Teen Patti, and various Slot Machines. There are also live gaming events and poker tournaments held regularly.

What is included in the Deltin Royale entry fee?

The Deltin Royale entry fee generally includes entry to the casino, complimentary play chips, unlimited food and beverages (alcoholic and non-alcoholic), and access to live entertainment shows.

Is there a dress code at Deltin Royale?

Yes, Deltin Royale has a smart casual dress code. Men should wear collared shirts or T-shirts, trousers or jeans, and closed-toe shoes. Women can wear dresses, skirts, or smart casual outfits. Sleeveless shirts, shorts, flip-flops, and beachwear are not allowed.

What are the age restrictions for entering Deltin Royale?

Guests must be at least 21 years old to enter Deltin Royale and participate in the gaming activities.

Are there any VIP or couple packages available at Deltin Royale?

Can I dine at Deltin Royale without playing games?

Yes, guests can enjoy dining at Deltin Royale even without engaging in gaming activities. The casino offers a variety of multi-cuisine buffet spreads and à la carte options, along with a premium bar.

Are there any guidelines for behavior at Deltin Royale?

Visitors are expected to adhere to respectful behavior. Disruptive conduct may result in eviction without refund. The casino promotes responsible gaming and encourages guests to play within their limits.

How do I reach Deltin Royale?

Deltin Royale is located on the Mandovi River in Panaji, Goa. It is easily accessible by road from various parts of Goa, with nearby hotels, taxis, and shuttle services available for convenience.

accordion_sections.title: What is Deltin Royale?
accordion_sections.content: Deltin Royale is India’s largest floating casino, located on the Mandovi River in Goa. It offers a luxurious gaming experience with a variety of table games, slot machines, live entertainment, and fine dining.

accordion_sections.title: What games are available at Deltin Royale?
accordion_sections.content: Deltin Royale features a wide range of games, including Poker, Blackjack, Roulette, Baccarat, Teen Patti, and various Slot Machines. There are also live gaming events and poker tournaments held regularly.

accordion_sections.title: What is the entry fee for Deltin Royale?
accordion_sections.content: The entry fee for Deltin Royale typically ranges from ₹3,000 to ₹5,000 per person, depending on the day and package. VIP packages start from ₹8,000 and include higher-value chips, access to exclusive areas, and personalized services.

accordion_sections.title: What is included in the Deltin Royale entry fee?
accordion_sections.content: The Deltin Royale entry fee generally includes entry to the casino, complimentary play chips, unlimited food and beverages (alcoholic and non-alcoholic), and access to live entertainment shows.

accordion_sections.title: Is there a dress code at Deltin Royale?
accordion_sections.content: Yes, Deltin Royale has a smart casual dress code. Men should wear collared shirts or T-shirts, trousers or jeans, and closed-toe shoes. Women can wear dresses, skirts, or smart casual outfits. Sleeveless shirts, shorts, flip-flops, and beachwear are not allowed.

accordion_sections.title: What are the age restrictions for entering Deltin Royale?
accordion_sections.content: Guests must be at least 21 years old to enter Deltin Royale and participate in the gaming activities.

accordion_sections.title: Are there any VIP or couple packages available at Deltin Royale?
accordion_sections.content: Yes, Deltin Royale offers VIP packages and couple packages that include exclusive access to premium areas, higher-value chips, and personalized services. These packages provide a more luxurious experience with added benefits.

accordion_sections.title: Can I dine at Deltin Royale without playing games?
accordion_sections.content: Yes, guests can enjoy dining at Deltin Royale even without engaging in gaming activities. The casino offers a variety of multi-cuisine buffet spreads and à la carte options, along with a premium bar.

accordion_sections.title: Are there any guidelines for behavior at Deltin Royale?
accordion_sections.content: Visitors are expected to adhere to respectful behavior. Disruptive conduct may result in eviction without refund. The casino promotes responsible gaming and encourages guests to play within their limits.

accordion_sections.title: How do I reach Deltin Royale?
accordion_sections.content: Deltin Royale is located on the Mandovi River in Panaji, Goa. It is easily accessible by road from various parts of Goa, with nearby hotels, taxis, and shuttle services available for convenience.
